fee_notes: $80,000 for new franchisees; $70,000 for existing franchisees opening new School; 60% of then-current existing franchisee fee for purchasing an existing School; $50,000 for qualifying VetFran veterans (first School only). Additional fees: Real Estate Fee $25,000-$70,000; Initial Training Fee $35,000.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee for a Primrose franchise (the "Initial Fee") for a new franchisee for a new School is $80,000. If you are an existing franchisee that meets our qualifications, the Initial Fee for a new School will be $70,000...If you are a qualifying veteran or member of the U.S. Armed Forces, the Initial Franchise Fee for your first School only will be $50,000.
